page0.text:
"That settles it then. I'm coming in. Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"
...

page1.text:
"Illya? What are you spacing out for? On the way here, you were so excited to stay over at Shirou's house."
"I don't what you're talking about. I wasn't that excited."

page2.text:
Her voice sounds listless.
Illya's face is downcast as she stares into the corridor.
...It's as if the centimeters-high step is a high wall.

page3.text:
"...Shirou.
Where is that woman sleeping?"
She asks.
Illya glares at Sakura, all of her earlier enthusiasm gone.

page4.text:
"Huh? Sakura's room is in the separate guesthouse."
"Okay. Then Rin can stay there. I'll sleep anywhere besides the guesthouse."
"Is that so? You can have the tatami room, then."
Tohsaka and Illya casually banter. They seem close enough to be on a first-name basis now.
